item.text: {"search_note":"I found no credible 2024 evidence that Tshisekedi had or enabled any nuclear proliferation network. I also found no evidence of him resisting nuclear proliferation by allies or domestic factions, because there was no visible nuclear proliferation issue to resist. The real-world analogue in the DRC record is conventional proxy militarization: Tshisekedi publicly supported disarmament programs, but his government also depended on proxy militias like Wazalendo. Strict nuclear reading: not applicable; no evidence of nuclear proliferation activity. Broader proxy-militarization reading: mixed. Tshisekedi showed some resistance through disarmament and command discipline, but he also tolerated and operationally relied on armed proxies.","evidence":[{"title":"Programme de désarmement et démobilisation : une alternative pour la paix et la cohésion sociale","publisher":"ACP","date":"2024-03-22","url":"https://acp.cd/nation/programme-de-desarmement-et-demobilisation-une-alternative-pour-la-paix-et-la-cohesion-sociale/","summary":"The government described P-DDRCS as a national stabilization, peace, and cohesion program that also aims to restore state authority where it was absent.
